correctness.rationale: In \(K_1\vee nK_m\), a center-free selected set has induced degree at most one exactly when each clique blade contributes at most two vertices; with the center selected, its induced degree forces at most one outer vertex in total. These two disjoint cases give the stated polynomial immediately. Inclusion-maximal center-containing sets are exactly center-plus-one-outer-vertex sets, while a center-free set is maximal exactly when it chooses two vertices from every blade. The inspected exhaustive checker independently tests induced degrees and all one-vertex extensions for every tested parameter pair with at most 18 vertices.
residual_risks: Finite exhaustive checks corroborate but do not replace the arbitrary-parameter proof.
